CHK-015 ("Enforce the matcher array count bound of one to maxMatchers, rejecting a vacuous or oversized matcher set as R1-3") was added in PLAN phase: PLAN scope reviewer (scope-check _hash b67028b4) found the section 1.6 R1-3 matcher COUNT bound (0 matchers / more than maxMatchers) named in no checklist title; CHK-002 covers only the per-value byte-length bound maxMatcherLen, which is a different bound. Adding as a named item so gate review covers it.

CHK-016 ("Require a class matcher value to name a registered matcherClassRegistry entry case-sensitively, rejecting an unregistered class as R1-3") was added in PLAN phase: PLAN scope reviewer (scope-check _hash b67028b4) found the section 1.6 R1-3 class-registry membership check named in no checklist title; CHK-008 covers only the sole-present-in-red rule, not membership. Adding as a named item so gate review covers it.

16 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Declare the assertion envelope schema with unique matcher ids and a kind enum limited to literal-line and class with no pattern language + Enforce trimmed literal values within one to maxMatcherLen bytes and the closed stream and polarity enums are performed simultaneously?)

understanding still has 3 undigested unknowns: Whether the entropy floor comparison is inclusive - RESOLVED: section 1.3 rule 2 states admissible iff len >= minMatcherLen AND entropyBits >= minMatcherEntropyBits, so both comparisons are inclusive (>=).; Whether class matchers are subject to rule 2 - RESOLVED: section 1.3 exempts class matchers from rule 2 because their breadth is bounded by the policy registry, but rule 3 still forbids a class matcher from being the sole present-in-red evidence.; Which R1-x tag carries path-validation failures - RESOLVED: R1-3, which the spec states explicitly covers path validation and not only matcher bounds; R1-2 is reserved for the minimum-specificity failure.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation
